articles.title: Retiring Bell County Judges Jones Gauntt Recognized
articles.excerpt: Gauntt was judge of the 27th District Court in Bell County from 2013 until his retirement on Dec. 31, 2024 (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: New Judges Spend First Day in Bell County Courtrooms
articles.excerpt: He was the 13th judge of the court, which was created in 1885 and hears criminal cases, and he succeeded Judge Joe Carroll, who had served 24 years; at his swearing-in he said he had spent some 40 years on the defense side of the courtroom (KDH).

articles.title: Local District Court Judge Will Continue to Hear Marvin Guy Case New Trial Date to
articles.excerpt: As the 27th District Court's judge he presided over the Marvin Guy capital murder case, the county's oldest unresolved capital case at the time, and denied the state's request for a visiting judge (KDH).

articles.title: Races for District Judges JP Contested
articles.excerpt: He did not seek re-election in 2024 (KDH).
